This Standard build controls fan speed and reads RPM. It never touches
lighting, so it stays out of the way of OpenRGB or any other lighting tool.
The ARGB build (FanControl.LianLi.Argb.dll) hands the fan lighting to your
motherboard's ARGB header; the Lighting build (FanControl.LianLi.Lighting.dll)
keeps the look you designed in L-Connect. Install only one build at a time.
